svg.title: One repo. Four tasks.
svg.desc: A 24-second replay cycles through all four website tasks using the same 125 taxonomy files: editor 14, webhook 3, billing 23, and Widen 125. Marks morph into each recorded import-distance layout. The vague task keeps every file in a filled disc. Hover highlights actual Anchor connections. Reduced motion shows the finished editor result.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: INSPECT THE SLICE / FOUR RECORDED TASKS

text.font-family: Newsreader, ui-serif, 'Iowan Old Style', Charter, Georgia, serif
